title: Terminal manager
subtitle: Run interactive shells, count terminals across the machine, and schedule scripts.
desktopOnly: The Terminal manager is only available in the AionUi desktop app.
bridgeUnavailable: Terminal service is not running yet. The feature will be ready once the desktop bridge is connected.

sessions.title: App sessions
sessions.empty: No terminals yet. Click + to start one.
sessions.createError: Could not start a new terminal.

view.noSession: Pick a session from the list, or create a new terminal.
view.initError: The terminal renderer failed to start. Try reloading the window.
view.inputPlaceholder: Type a command and press Enter (Shift+Enter for newline). Ctrl+C sends interrupt.
view.mtuiConflictBody: Review the diff before accepting token {{token}}.

system.title: System terminals
system.hint: Read-only view of shell processes the OS reports. AionUi cannot interact with these — only count and list them.
system.empty: No shell processes detected on the machine.

schedule.title: Schedules
schedule.name: Name
schedule.cronHint: Five-field cron expression. Example: 0 9 * * * fires at 9:00 every day.
schedule.hint: Schedules only fire while AionUi is running. They are local to this machine and never exposed over remote channels.
schedule.empty: No schedules yet. Add one to launch a tool on a cron expression.
